top_comments.author: Wyvek
top_comments.body:
I'm on 2.1.87 and same issue. It can hang in the main agent, it can hang in the subagent, it can hang in multiple subagents at the same time. Seems like buggy implementation of how datacenter infrastructure is overloaded (or maybe just bugs). Either way, this exists in 2.1.87 as well for me.

How this manifests - no tokens are being generated for minutes (sometimes 10+ minutes) at a time.

top_comments.author: sangyeopchae
top_comments.body:
Experiencing the same issue here.

Claude Code version: 2.1.87
Model: Claude Opus 4.6
Platform: macOS

I'm encountering the same problem. Token generation stalls completely, with `Flibbertigibbeting…` displayed in red text. This happens consistently — I've tried opening multiple separate sessions, but the issue reproduces across every single one of them. No tokens are generated beyond that point, and the process just hangs indefinitely.
